plan.title: Rejecting a bid updates ranking totals

steps.note: Open the existing closed RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Reject Vendor B's bid from its response row.
Confirm that the rejection confirmation dialog opened.
Confirm rejection of Vendor B's bid.
Verify Vendor B's row now shows the rejected status.
Verify the best-offer indicator is present after the rejection.
Open the comparison grid after rejection to inspect the surviving ranked bid.
Verify the remaining active bid is ranked according to the recalculated RFQ amount.
Verify Vendor A is now rank 1.
Verify Vendor A's displayed amount and total are recalculated consistently from its rate and quantity.
